latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cmdlogger: record and forward full I/O for any command.

- Logs stdin, stdout, and stderr to a file with real-time console output.
- Supports custom log file locations via --log-path.
- Distinguishes input, output, and error streams in log with clear prefixes.
- Enables full command execution tracing for debugging, builds, CI/CD, or monitoring.
- Caution: logs all user input, including sensitive data, for interactive commands.
